context: Synthetic/runtime engineering comparison, not biological replication.

record.purpose: Engineering runtime selection only; no participant target-error or scientific outcome selection.
record.candidate_timing_seconds: Slower sampling time of the two fresh five-second calls at that count, excluding separately reported load time.
record.new_run_estimate_seconds: 104 times candidate timing plus 90 seconds startup/reporting allowance; treats even short trailing contexts as full windows conservatively.
record.old_run_estimate_seconds: Remaining full 1280-sample contexts times 51.5 seconds; ignores cost of short trailing contexts conservatively.
record.numerical_tolerance_limitation: Operational synthetic numerical-consistency check, not proof of identical predictions for every input or scientific equivalence.
record.limitations: Single laptop, small sequential benchmark, existing job continues in parallel. Thermal state and shared resources can change actual runtime; estimated savings are not guaranteed. Choose by time only among candidates meeting all guards.
